statement: Retail Wii U Pro stick calibration storage, actual resting offsets, report cadence and battery or charging-bit universality remain unmeasured. The Linux auto-centering and SDL battery scales are consumer heuristics, not evidence of retail EEPROM contents or reference-unit behavior.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Hardware comparison and private analysis would be required; no vendor firmware analysis in this corpus.
